messages:
sam: Quick thread - proposing a minimal pilot scope for Optimize Toolkit so we can sign two customers fast.

lee: what are the absolute must-haves?

sam: Must-haves: eval-triggered alerts to console+webhook, PII-redacted samples with short diffs, quantization advisor that gives up to 2 recommendations with simple impact estimates. No auto-apply in phase 1.

nora: Ops notes: cap profiling at 500 samples/model/run for pilot and default weekly cadence. Must show cost estimate before any hosted profiling run.

jake: UX MVP: list of failing prompts, two short outputs side-by-side, small bar for cost delta and ms change, accept/ignore per rec. Residency badge is nice-to-have.

sam: Draft acceptance criteria: 
- AC1: Alerts delivered to console+webhook within 30m 95% of the time.
- AC2: All examples redacted by default; full context only via customer-hosted link.
- AC3: Quant advisor shows top-2 configs with sample diffs and estimated latency/cost delta.
- AC4: Profiling cap = 500 samples/model/run for pilot; cost estimate shown pre-run.
- AC5: Pilot opt-in per-model; advisory-only during Phase 1.

lee: econ gate for Phase 2 auto-apply: require >=10% unit cost reduction OR >=60ms p95 latency drop on both pilot customers, plus impact_score >= 0.6.

nora: safety: rollback if quality drops >=3% absolute on labeled harness or customer reports regression within 24h.

ops-bot: reminder set for 1805630000: "Optimize Toolkit pilot artifacts due" :bell:

sam: Action items: @nora prototype profiler+cost estimate; @jake mockup UI; @lee run econ sim; I'll draft the initiative backing doc and loop in legal/privacy. We'll lock scope if no objections by EOD Fri.
